private_snapshot: training-v3 (best inference from manifest timestamps; this run predates the meta.json/changelog tooling, see note below)
changes: Fixed a train/serve feature skew in the `candidates_in_message` structured feature: training counted padded pair-rows in candidate_pairs.jsonl (inflated by random_topup/background negative sampling to ~3-4 per message), serving counted the real candidate count from mapper.identify() (often just 1)
Retrained both classifiers on the same post-fix snapshot and re-ran the frozen test-set evaluation

latency.note: see reports/pipeline_latency_lgbm.md and reports/pipeline_latency_lr.md in the private workspace; LightGBM's p99 on multi-candidate messages is close to/over the 100ms budget, which is why it stayed a shadow model instead of going live

known_limitations: classic-lr-v3 precision (0.873) is below the 98% target used as the production go/no-go bar
lightgbm-shadow-v2 clears both precision/recall targets on the frozen test set but hasn't cleared the latency bar for multi-candidate messages
candidate recall itself is capped around 97.5% upstream of these classifiers (see private workspace reports/data_audit.md), independent of this fix
reconstruction_note: This run predates the meta.json/run.json tooling added later. Numbers here are transcribed from reports/final_test_evaluation.md and code comments in src/semantic_matcher.py in the private workspace, not captured live at training time -- included as the first experiments/ entry precisely to demonstrate why the tooling was added.
